panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: H&E section of a vertebral biopsy showing infiltrating squamous cell carcinoma nests in bone, stated in text to be compatible with the patient's known hypopharyngeal primary (positive CK5/6 and p40), so it is a specific histologic manifestation of hypopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma. B: H&E section demonstrating keratin pearl formation and pleomorphic squamous cells infiltrating bone, consistent with metastatic hypopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma as stated in the text. C: p40 immunohistochemistry showing positive nuclear staining in the metastatic squamous cell carcinoma deposits, supporting squamous differentiation of the hypopharyngeal primary. D: Cytokeratin 5/6 immunohistochemistry with strong positive staining in the metastatic carcinoma deposits, corroborating squamous differentiation of the hypopharyngeal primary.
